void_cand2 = pm_er & (img > thr)
lab2, blobs2 = label_blobs(void_cand2, min_area=5)

for b in blobs2:

        print("VOID:", b)

void_mask = np.isin(lab2, [b['id'] for b in voids])

print("ratio pct:", 100*void_mask.sum()/pm.sum())
show(overlay(img, [pm, void_mask]), "voids only")
